name: savvy-progress-plus
description: Progress bar above the prompt for any multi-step work (savvy-flow, the task list, 2+ subagents), plus a crew panel (/crew): running, finished and planned subagents with model, effort fit, budget warnings, cost and time. Fork of savvy-progress.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, fr, ru, he or ar (Hebrew and Arabic are drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the crew panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

budgetTokens.title: Token budget per subagent
budgetTokens.description: A subagent past this many tokens turns red and raises a toast; 0 turns the check off

budgetUsd.title: Cost budget per subagent (USD)
budgetUsd.description: A subagent past this estimated cost turns red and raises a toast; 0 turns the check off
